mapper.insert: INSERT INTO erp_center_notice (center_notice_key, title, sub_title, content, link_url, image, icon, view_count, user_code, center_code, created_at) VALUES (#{centerNoticeKey}, #{title}, #{subTitle}, #{content}, #{linkUrl}, #{image}, #{icon}, #{viewCount}, #{userCode}, #{centerCode}, SYSDATETIME())
mapper.update: UPDATE erp_center_notice SET is_delete = 'Y', deleted_at = SYSDATETIME() WHERE id = #{id} AND is_delete = 'N'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO erp_center_notice (center_notice_key, title, sub_title, content, icon, view_count, user_code, center_code, created_at) VALUES (#{centerNoticeKey}, #{title}, #{subTitle}, #{content}, #{icon}, #{viewCount}, #{userCode}, #{centerCode}, SYSDATETIME())
INSERT INTO erp_student_notice_map (notice_key, student_id, send_yn, created_at) VALUES (#{centerNoticeKey}, #{studentId}, 'Y', SYSDATETIME())
mapper.update: UPDATE erp_center_notice SET title = #{title}, sub_title = #{subTitle}, icon = #{icon}, content = #{content}, link_url = #{linkUrl}, image = #{image} WHERE id = #{id} AND is_delete = 'N'
mapper.select: SELECT n.id AS id, n.center_notice_key AS centerNoticeKey, n.title AS title, n.sub_title AS subTitle, n.content AS rawContent, n.created_at AS createdAt, n.icon AS icon, n.link_url AS linkUrl, n.view_count AS viewCount, u.user_name AS userName FROM erp_center_notice n JOIN erp_user u ON n.user_code = u.user_code WHERE n.center_code = #{centerCode} AND n.user_code = #{userCode} AND is_delete = 'N' ORDER BY n.created_at DESC;

SELECT s.student_id AS studentId, s.student_name AS studentName, s.app_token AS appToken, hc.class_name AS hanClassName, hc.class_type AS hanClassType, bc.class_name AS bookClassName, bc.class_type AS bookClasstype, gc.grade_name AS grade FROM erp_student s JOIN erp_teacher_assign ta ON s.student_id = ta.student_id LEFT JOIN erp_class_code hc ON ta.assign_han_class = hc.class_key LEFT JOIN erp_class_code bc ON ta.assign_book_class = bc.class_key JOIN erp_grade_code gc ON s.grade_key = gc.grade_key WHERE (ta.assign_han_teacher = #{userCode} OR ta.assign_book_teacher = #{userCode}) AND s.center_code = #{centerCode} ORDER BY s.student_name ASC

SELECT n.id AS id, n.center_notice_key AS centerNoticeKey, n.title AS title, n.sub_title AS subTitle, n.content AS rawContent, n.created_at AS createdAt, n.icon AS icon, n.link_url AS linkUrl, n.view_count AS viewCount, u.user_name AS userName FROM erp_center_notice n JOIN erp_user u ON n.user_code = u.user_code WHERE n.center_code = #{centerCode} AND n.id = #{id} ORDER BY n.created_at DESC;

select TOP(10) cn.id AS idx, center_notice_key AS noticeKey, cn.title AS title, cn.sub_title AS subtitle, cn.content AS content, cn.icon AS subicon, cn.created_at AS sdate from erp_student_notice_map snm join erp_center_notice cn on snm.notice_key = cn.center_notice_key where snm.student_id = #{studentId} ORDER BY cn.created_at DESC;

SELECT id AS idx, center_notice_key AS noticeKey, title AS title, sub_title AS subtitle, content AS note, icon AS subicon, image AS imagepath, link_url AS linkurl, created_at AS sdate FROM erp_center_notice where id = #{id} ORDER BY created_at DESC;
